verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for Codex, since it runs cloud tasks and is offered on Business and Enterprise plans. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency location. Local CLI execution, local chat history, sandbox permissions and RBAC are related features, not region or residency controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
